name: Vizcaíno charts the California coast
traveler: Sebastián Vizcaíno and Antonio de la Ascensión
summary: Sixty years after Cabrillo, Vizcaíno is sent to find harbours for the Manila galleons on their way home. His charts and the names he gives (San Diego, Monterey, Santa Barbara) stay on Spanish maps for a century and a half.

stops.note: Renames Cabrillo's San Miguel after San Diego.
Names the channel for Saint Barbara.
Praises the bay, too generously, as a fine harbour for the galleons.
Scurvy cripples the crews; one ship reaches about 43°N.
Home with charts that later Spaniards rely on.
